findings: Phone registration works end to end through the wallet app's in-app browser.
The manifest was saved at the repository proof path (oar.json), breaking the repository claim. oar-web now refuses a manifest URI ending in oar.json and offers an Update step to repoint the record.
The manifest URI follows a branch (main); a later edit to the file would stop it matching the onchain hash. The wizard now suggests a commit-pinned link.
